entries.67833da5a157edad: This is the core business of HANWA CO., LTD., which buys and sells steel products and also performs processing and storage. Major domestic affiliates include Hanwa Eco Steel Co., Ltd., Hanwa Distribution Center Tokyo Co., Ltd., Hanwa Distribution Center Osaka Co., Ltd., Hanwa Distribution Center Nagoya Co., Ltd., and Hanwa Steel Service Co., Ltd., and major overseas consolidated subsidiaries include HANWA STEEL SERVICE MEXICANA, S.A. In the table of major facilities, the domestic subsidiaries with storage and processing facilities are Hanwa Distribution Center Osaka Co., Ltd., Hanwa Distribution Center Nagoya Co., Ltd., Hirouchi Steel Co., Ltd., Tanaka Tekko Hanbai Co., Ltd., and Hanwa Daisan Co., Ltd., and the overseas subsidiaries with steel sheet processing facilities are Chōfu Fushūkō Chūshin (Suzhou) Co., Ltd., HANWA STEEL SERVICE MEXICANA, S.A. DE C.V., PT. HANWA STEEL SERVICE INDONESIA, and HANWA STEEL SERVICE (THAILAND) CO., LTD. (as of March 31, 2026). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,034,009 million, the largest of the business categories, and the number of employees was 3,601 (as of March 31, 2026). Revenue including intersegment transactions decreased 7.2% year on year, due to lower prices of various steel products and a decline in the handled volume of steel sheets. From the third quarter of the fiscal year ended March 2026, COSMO STEEL HOLDINGS LTD. moved from this category to the category “Overseas Sales Subsidiaries.”

entries.ba3459d5fe9f0978: Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,034,009 million for the Steel Business, ¥465,114 million for Overseas Sales Subsidiaries, ¥379,018 million for the Energy and Living Materials Business, ¥281,236 million for the Recycled Metal Business, ¥224,285 million for the Primary Metal Business, ¥148,793 million for the Food Business and ¥130,212 million for Other, totaling ¥2,662,669 million in consolidated sales. Revenue from product sales is recognized at the point the product is delivered to the customer or at the time of acceptance. However, for domestic sales where the period from shipment to the transfer of control is a normal period, revenue is recognized at the time of shipment. Contracted construction work is recognized over a certain period according to progress on the work. When acting as an agent, revenue is presented on a net basis, being the total consideration received from the customer less cost of sales. Payment is generally received within six months from the point at which the performance obligation is satisfied.
